title: AROS: Affordance Recognition with One-Shot Human Stances
summary: A one-shot geometric descriptor of human-scene interactions using proximity and clearance around articulated human poses.

mechanisms.name: One-shot human-scene affordance
mechanisms.description: Characterizes where a human pose can interact with a scene using contact-proximity and collision-clearance geometry rather than object class alone.
mechanisms.limitations: Requires 3D geometry and an example stance; crowd preference and physical plausibility do not establish mobile navigation, accessibility benefit, or safety.
